title: Fetch 4 Items from Multiple Sources in Fetched Phase
trigger: agent is in the 'fetched' phase and a list of target sources (e.g., huggingface, github, zenodo, openalex, openclaw, wikipedia) is available for item retrieval
action: for each source in the target list, fetch exactly 4 items (metadata or records) via the source's designated access method
rationale: retrieving a fixed quota from multiple, diverse sources ensures a broad and balanced initial item pool, mitigating dependence on a single repository
caveats: if a source returns fewer than 4 items (e.g., due to exhaustion or filtering), accept the reduced count and log the shortfall for potential later retry
some sources may impose rate limits or require authentication; if a fetch fails with a permission/rate error, skip the source and flag it for the next cycle

title: Do Not Blindly Label Papers as Relevant in Judging Phase
trigger: Agent is in phase 'judged' and about to assess a paper's relevance to a topic
action: Instead of immediately outputting 'relevant: <title>', first retrieve the paper's abstract and verify that its content genuinely matches the target topic. Only if the match is clear, output the 'relevant' label; otherwise, mark it as 'needs manual review' or 'not relevant'.
rationale: All input traces show that labeling papers as relevant based solely on title led to zero utility, indicating systematic misclassification. A preceding abstract check can prevent this failure.
caveats: If abstract retrieval fails or times out, mark the paper as 'needs manual review' rather than assuming relevance.
Ensure the topic definition is precise enough to avoid ambiguous matches during abstract verification.

title: Project claim proposals from a source using the Granite model
trigger: Agent is in the 'projected' phase and a source identifier (e.g., zenodo:ID, huggingface:ID, arxiv:ID) is present in the state.
action: Project claim proposals from $SOURCE across $NUM_FACETS facets using the model ibm-granite/granite-4.1-8b-20260429, outputting candidates via the gate.
rationale: Across multiple cycles, the same model successfully projected proposals from various sources (zenodo, huggingface, arxiv) with different facet counts, indicating a reliable templated action for this phase.
caveats: If the source identifier format does not match expected prefixes (zenodo:, huggingface:, arxiv:), the model may fail to parse the source and produce no proposals.
Ensure that the model's internal gate does not filter out all candidates, which would result in an empty projection.

title: Read queued papers during read phase
trigger: agent is in phase 'read' and has a non-empty queue of papers to process
action: for each paper in the queue, execute: read full text of <paper_title>: <N> claim(s) [<arxiv_id>]
rationale: In all traces, the agent consistently reads full texts of queued papers when in the read phase, which is the designated behavior for this stage.
caveats: Reading full text may be resource-intensive; consider pre-filtering or prioritizing papers based on abstract or metadata to avoid unnecessary processing
Utility from reading alone may be zero if downstream tasks cannot utilize the extracted text; ensure integration with analysis or memory modules is active

title: Propose Contested Claims via DeepSeek When Phase is Escalated
trigger: agent's phase is 'escalated' and there are contested claims requiring resolution
action: Propose N claims via DeepSeek escalation using model deepseek-v4-pro with replayed=False; claims are candidates, authoritative decision deferred to Layer 9
rationale: Specialized model generation provides diverse candidate solutions while preserving separation of proposal and decision authority, suitable for escalated states with unresolved claims.
caveats: If proposed claims are insufficient or incorrect, Layer 9 may reject all, necessitating a new proposal cycle
Number of proposed claims may vary; ensure at least one claim is generated to avoid empty escalation
This step yields zero direct utility; it is procedural—follow up with claim evaluation and selection to realize value
